info.name: Sokoon
info.description:
Sokoon (سكون) — Premium Real Estate Ecosystem  
Sokoon (derived from the Arabic word for "Self Piece") is a state-of-the-art, high-performance real estate platform designed to simplify property listing, exploration, and transactions. Built with a focus on modern aesthetics, speed, and reliability, Darak provides a robust backend API powering sleek user-facing web and mobile client interfaces.

Key Features:  
Intuitive Property Discovery: Search and filter listings with ease using advanced criteria like location, price tags, layout details, and custom amenities.  
User & Profile Management: Safe, cookie-based JWT authentication matching user properties to personalized dashboard analytics.  
Real-time Interactions: Integrated via Django Channels for live chat and immediate notification updates between buyers, sellers, and agents.  
Analytics & View Tracking: Smart, generic view tracking built into the database to measure listing popularity and engagement levels.
